name: Barbell Decline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, hook your feet securely, lie back, and take a slightly wider-than-shoulder underhand grip on the barbell.
Unrack carefully over your chest with thumbs wrapped around the bar and shoulder blades pinned back.
Tuck your elbows close to your ribs and lower the bar slowly down to your lower chest.
Press the bar smoothly back up to full extension and rerack with control when finished.
tips: Always wrap both thumbs securely around the bar for safety with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides to protect your wrists and shoulders.
